confirmDestructiveTools.name: Permissions · Confirm destructive tools
confirmDestructiveTools.hint: Off by default. When on, the AI runs a tool that deletes or overwrites only on its second call: the first shows a preview with the result of the dry run and a confirmation that is valid for five minutes and once. That way it can ask you before it destroys anything. Only works with an MCP server of this generation or later.
